Temporarily accepted real advisory, not a patch or a false positive. Transitive through react-scripts 5.0.1 -> webpack-dev-server 4.15.2 -> selfsigned 2.4.1 -> node-forge 1.3.3. As of 2026-10-03 no patched node-forge release is available; versions through 1.4.0 are affected. Not present in the HockeyPlanner production runtime bundle path: source does not import node-forge or selfsigned. Current build/E2E/staging paths do not run webpack-dev-server: react-scripts build produces static assets, E2E uses the production build with a custom Node HTTP server, and staging publishes static assets to nginx. No repository HTTPS=true or auto-TLS dev-server configuration exists. No current reachable use of the vulnerable RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature-verification path was identified. Acceptance is temporary only; remediation owner and follow-up are Linear HP-87, which remains In Progress. Future CRA/webpack-dev-server toolchain removal or upgrade is required for durable removal of this dependency.
